installCommand: if [ -d "frontend" ]; then (cd backend && npm install --include=dev) && (cd frontend && npm install --include=dev); else npm install --include=dev; fi
buildCommand: if [ -d "frontend" ]; then (cd frontend && npm run build) && mkdir -p dist && (cp -R frontend/dist/. dist/ 2>/dev/null || true); else npm run build; fi
